name: MiniMax-H3-30s

gpu.scope: This exact GPU configuration was tested; other GPUs were not validated for this application.

video.test_scene: One red fox walking through green woodland with ambient sound
video.visual_review: First, final and all six seam-adjacent frame pairs reviewed; subject and woodland remain recognizable without black or corrupt sampled frames. Full human playback and listening were not audited. This is a sampled visual review, not a general quality guarantee.

reboot_evidence: After real platform power-off and power-on, one ComfyUI process started as PID96 with parent PID1 and /system_stats on port6006 returned ComfyUI0.43.0, PyTorch2.12.1+cu130 and the CUDA GPU. No manual service launch was used after reboot.
